d.ko: Zhao Sheng, a retired postman, has been suffering from dementia over the past years. He insists that his partner Qi Mei is waiting for him under a peach tree. Zhao Sheng’s family didn't want him to leave with any regrets and decided to go and find that peach tree he had been talking about...

d.zh: 《长梦》是一款讲述迷糊老头穿越时空寻找爱人的像素叙事游戏。由《坏小孩》开发者倾情打造，幽默接地气的文案风格、上世纪怀旧背景，将给你带来一场独一无二的体验！
